instruction: Inspect only the local files under sources plus source_manifest.json and write method_ir.json. Reconstruct the bounded publication-visible method needed to evaluate CLAIM_SIGLIP2_B16_256_CORE: for fixed-resolution ViT-B/16 at 256px, compare the corresponding SigLIP and SigLIP 2 published ImageNet-1k validation zero-shot classification result and COCO text-to-image / image-to-text recall@1 results, then state whether publication-visible material is sufficient to reproduce those evaluations. Do not use model prior to fill missing details. Output exactly schema_version, claim, protocol_fields, and execution_readiness. schema_version must be 1. claim must contain exactly claim_id, comparison, and evidence_refs; claim_id must be CLAIM_SIGLIP2_B16_256_CORE. comparison must contain exactly siglip and siglip2; each must contain exactly imagenet1k_val, coco_text_to_image_recall_at_1, coco_image_to_text_recall_at_1, and evidence_refs. For this frozen fixture, all six published comparison values are present in the local sources and each numeric result field must be a finite JSON number. Locate them in the frozen sources; do not substitute model prior. Each siglip/siglip2 comparison evidence_refs array must be sorted and unique and must include at least one reference to tables/zeroshot_main.tex. protocol_fields must contain exactly checkpoint_identity, architecture_resolution, text_tokenizer_normalization, image_preprocessing, imagenet1k_evaluation, coco_retrieval_evaluation, metric_definitions, software_runtime, randomness_repetition. Each protocol field must contain exactly status, value, evidence_refs, and absence_search. status must be one of EXPLICIT_PAPER, EXPLICIT_CHECKPOINT_README, INFERABLE_WITH_EVIDENCE, AMBIGUOUS, CONTRADICTORY, MISSING, NOT_APPLICABLE. For MISSING: value must be null, evidence_refs must be an empty array, and absence_search must be a non-empty string describing which local source material was checked. For NOT_APPLICABLE: value must be a non-empty explanatory string, evidence_refs must be an empty array, and absence_search must be null. For every other status: value must be a non-empty string, evidence_refs must contain at least one valid reference, and absence_search must be null. All evidence_refs arrays must be sorted and unique. Evidence refs are relative to the sources directory, not the workspace root. The only valid source path names are document.tex, tables/zeroshot_main.tex, and README_siglip2.md. Do not prefix them with sources/. Each reference must be exactly source:<source-root-relative-path>:L<start> or source:<source-root-relative-path>:L<start>-L<end>, using line numbers from the raw local source files. execution_readiness must contain exactly status, blocking_fields, and notes; status must be RUNNABLE, PARTIAL, or BLOCKED; blocking_fields must be a sorted unique array containing only protocol_fields keys; notes must be a string. Preserve ambiguity and missing information rather than silently resolving it. Do not modify source files.
